import sys

def solve():
    t = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
        b = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
        c = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

        p = [0] * n
        p[0] = a[0]
        for i in range(1, n):
            prev = p[i-1]
            options = [a[i], b[i], c[i]]
            for opt in options:
                if opt != prev:
                    p[i] = opt
                    break
        # Check circular condition
        if p[-1] == p[0]:
            # Need to adjust the last element
            last_options = [a[-1], b[-1], c[-1]]
            for opt in last_options:
                if opt != p[-2] and opt != p[0]:
                    p[-1] = opt
                    break
        print(' '.join(map(str, p)))

solve()
